purpose: Source copy and decision records for the existing native roadmap. This is not a runtime catalog schema, native feature-ID registry, unlock implementation or activation command.
sourceBasis: Approved content PRs #3–7, current Winter approvals and approved Winter Wave 2 artwork. Native app implementation is unverified. All Christmas artwork approved November 28, 2026; Christmas release configuration remains pending. The later explicit Christmas date decision approves December 15–30 inclusive; prices/acquisition/native activation remain pending. Later owner approval completes Christmas supported prices/acquisition and Frostbloom/Snow Lantern Winter dates/prices/acquisition; Animals stay deferred.

nativePorting.stableHandoffKeys: Retain these keys for mapping across handoffs; preserve existing native IDs and status conventions.
nativePorting.deduplication: Match by native ID or meaning, update matching subjects and add missing subjects once. Existing combined rows may represent several subjects without duplicate entries.
nativePorting.internalFields: All other fields document implementation and decisions; do not show raw technical metadata in the player roadmap.
nativePorting.sideEffects: Informational only. Opening the tab must not grant or activate content, change balances or mutate saved placements.
nativePorting.pendingImplementation: Map the displayed native status to actual verified implementation; content approval is not completion.
